name: cl_Si20
title: Si20 cluster
description: Gas-phase Si20. Ion-mobility measurements and DFT show prolate Si_n clusters built from stacked tricapped-trigonal-prism units up to n ~ 25, with compact isomers close in energy around n = 20 (Ho et al., Nature 392, 582 (1998)). NEP89 has two near-degenerate putative minima, a compact oblate GM and a prolate isomer only 2 meV higher (tight relaxation), both with 4-7-fold coordinated Si and Si-Si >= 2.41 A, so a hit (E <= E_best + e_tol) can be either isomer.
